extracted.name: Spicy Pretzels
extracted.description: Spicy pretzels are coated in a flavorful mixture of ranch-style dressing mix, cayenne, lemon pepper, and garlic salt in this easy, sweet snack recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) package dry Ranch-style dressing mix
instruction_lines: Mix together oil, dressing mix, garlic salt, cayenne, and lemon pepper in a small bowl until combined.

Place pretzels in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour in ranch dressing mixture. Seal the bag and shake to coat. Allow pretzels to marinate for about 2 hours before serving. Shake occasionally to maintain coating.
